Privacy Policy

Hermes Google Workspace Connector  ·  Last updated: September 28, 2026

Summary

This application has a single user: its owner. It accesses Google user data belonging to that owner, on that owner's own computer, for that owner's own benefit. No data is collected about anyone else, and no data is sold, shared, or transferred to any third party.

What data is accessed

When the owner grants access, this application may access the following data in the owner's own Google Account:

  • Gmail — message contents, headers, labels, and attachments
  • Google Calendar — event details, attendees, and calendars
  • Google Drive — file names, contents, metadata, and sharing settings
  • Google Sheets and Google Docs — document and spreadsheet contents
  • Google Contacts — names, email addresses, and phone numbers

How data is used

Accessed data is used solely to carry out instructions the owner gives to his local AI assistant — for example, searching email, summarizing a document, creating a calendar event, or organizing files. Data is never used for advertising, profiling, marketing, creditworthiness, or any purpose unrelated to the owner's direct request.

How data is stored

Data is processed and stored locally on the owner's own computer. The only persistent credential is an OAuth 2.0 refresh token, stored on that computer's local filesystem with owner-only permissions. No copy of any Google user data is stored on any server operated by this application, because this application operates no servers.

How data is shared

Google user data is not shared with any third party, with these narrow exceptions:

  • The configured language model provider. When the owner asks his assistant a question about his own data, the relevant content may be transmitted to the AI model provider the owner has personally configured and pays for, solely to generate the requested response.
  • Google's own APIs, which are the source of the data and the destination of any action the owner requests.
  • Legal requirement, if compelled by valid legal process.

Data retention and deletion

The owner may revoke this application's access at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions, which immediately and permanently ends all further access. Deleting the local token file on the owner's computer removes the stored credential. Because all data resides on the owner's own machine, the owner retains complete control over its deletion.

Compliance with Google's Limited Use requirements

This application's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Security

Access is granted only through Google's official OAuth 2.0 authorization flow. Credentials are stored locally with restrictive file permissions. The application is not publicly accessible, has no remote attack surface, and accepts no inbound connections.

Children

This application is not directed at children and is not available to the public.

Changes to this policy

Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. Continued use after a change constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

Contact

This is a private, single-user application. Questions about this policy may be raised through the Google Account that owns the Cloud project.
